steps.text: A key always starts with lk_: a client-chosen prefix or configuration is refused
Usage shows the key under its current name after a rename
Key writes draw on the shared writes budget: the key's own submissions spend it, and a create is then refused
Settings tells the user a create is refused
With the budget still spent, the owner revokes and deletes the leaked key from Settings

checks.name: API: create with {"prefix":"abc"} is 400 SERVER_ONLY_PROPERTY
API: create with {"configId":"default"} is 400 SERVER_ONLY_PROPERTY
API: nothing was created by the refused requests
API: a plain create returns an lk_ secret and an lk_ visible start
API: the key submits a Link
API: the key is renamed
API: the key submits another Link
API: Usage lists the key as the new name with both Links
Settings > Usage shows the row under the new name
API: the key's own submissions run the writes budget out within 120 in the minute
The 429 has Retry-After (1 to 60 seconds) and code writes
API: a create is refused in Better Auth's error shape
API: a rename is refused too
API: nothing was created
Settings shows the limit message and creates nothing
Revoke answers 200 with the budget spent
API: the key is disabled
The revoked key answers 401 on /api/v1/links
Delete of an active key answers 200 with the budget spent
Delete of the revoked key answers 200 with the budget spent
API: both keys are gone
The deleted key still answers 401
